info.description: A tea shop API with user authentication and product management
info.title: Tea Shop API

get.description: Get all addresses for the authenticated user

post.description: Add a new address for the authenticated user (max 2 addresses)

get.description: Get the default address for the authenticated user

put.description: Update an existing address by ID

get.description: Get a list of parent/main product categories (parent_id = null)
Get a list of featured tea categories (subcategories of Tea Leaves)
Get all products belonging to a specific category
Get a list of products with optional filtering

post.description: Add a new product to the database

get.description: Get a specific product by its ID

put.description: Update an existing product by ID

get.description: Get all reviews for a specific product

post.description: Add a new review for a product by the authenticated user

get.description: Get the profile information of the currently authenticated user

put.description: Update the profile information of the currently authenticated user

get.description: Get all active variants for a specific product

post.description: Add a new variant for a product

put.description: Update an existing variant by ID

post.description: Authenticate user and return access/refresh tokens
Use refresh token to get new access token
Register a new user with username, email, and password

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
